tadyathāgate kāle yadi bhavati tadā rekhāmadhye svadeśo jñeyaḥ .
athādau rekhā paścāccetprāk tatkālāntaraṃ ṣaṣṭihataṃ pañcabhiḥ sahasrairvibhajet .
labdhadeśāntarayojanāni grahasyārdhaṃ rātrānmadhyāhnaṃ yāvatpūrvaḥ kālo madhyāhnādapararātraṃ yāvadaparastatrārkasya kālamavilaṅghayan chāyādvayaṃ gṛhṇīyāt .
tatkarṇo vyatyāsena śaṃkuprācyaparānte rahitau tadanantaraṃ viṣuvacchāyāgrahaṇamiṣṭe'hni iṣṭadinākṣavaiṣuvatākṣāntamekadigabhimukhībhyaśchāyābhyo yuktaṃ svarāpakramaḥ tena trijyāhatā paramāpakramajyāyā vibhajet . labdhacāpamarkaḥ prathame pade dvitīyādbhāvācchuddhaḥ .
tṛtīyena yuktaḥ caturthe cakrācchuddhaḥ .
viṣuvacchāyā taruṇā ca hīyamānā ca cchāyā prathama padasthe'rke bhavati, ūnā vṛddhimatī dvitīyasthe, vṛddhimatyadhikā tṛtīyasthe, hīyamānādhikā caturthasthe, evamatītadivasārkasya tadarkasya ca vivaraṃ sphuṭabhuktiḥ .
ādityodayāstamayādvā candrodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā nagradaddharito'rkastena kālena candramā bhavati candrānnakṣatrajñānam, candrārkavivarāttithijñānaṃ tasmādahargaṇaḥ .
sphuṭārkādviparītakarmaṇā madhyamārkaḥ .
saurajīvayoścārātsaṃvatsaraḥ .
2.34.d:
तेषामवबोधः शोधनं च तेनैकद्वित्र्याक्षरप्राणाः तैः क्रमेण मेषवृषमिथुनाः प्राणहीनाः उत्क्रमेण कुलीरसिंहकन्यानाम् । युक्तस्वदेशे चरा व्युदयप्राणा भवन्ति त एवोत्क्रमेण तुलादीनां मीनादीनामपि अर्धदिनमध्याह्नच्छायाग्रमूलयाम्योत्तराग्रमूलाग्रपरिलेखमत्स्यमुखपुच्छरखा प्राच्यापरा आदित्यचन्द्रयोरन्यतमस्य देशान्तरकर्म विना ग्रहणं न कार्यम् ।
तद्यथागते काले यदि भवति तदा रेखामध्ये स्वदेशो ज्ञेयः ।
अथादौ रेखा पश्चाच्चेत्प्राक् तत्कालान्तरं षष्टिहतं पञ्चभिः सहस्रैर्विभजेत् ।
लब्धदेशान्तरयोजनानि ग्रहस्यार्धं रात्रान्मध्याह्नं यावत्पूर्वः कालो मध्याह्नादपररात्रं यावदपरस्तत्रार्कस्य कालमविलङ्घयन् छायाद्वयं गृह्णीयात् ।
तत्कर्णो व्यत्यासेन शंकुप्राच्यपरान्ते रहितौ तदनन्तरं विषुवच्छायाग्रहणमिष्टेऽह्नि इष्टदिनाक्षवैषुवताक्षान्तमेकदिगभिमुखीभ्यश्छायाभ्यो युक्तं स्वरापक्रमः तेन त्रिज्याहता परमापक्रमज्याया विभजेत् । लब्धचापमर्कः प्रथमे पदे द्वितीयाद्भावाच्छुद्धः ।
तृतीयेन युक्तः चतुर्थे चक्राच्छुद्धः ।
विषुवच्छाया तरुणा च हीयमाना च च्छाया प्रथम पदस्थेऽर्के भवति, ऊना वृद्धिमती द्वितीयस्थे, वृद्धिमत्यधिका तृतीयस्थे, हीयमानाधिका चतुर्थस्थे, एवमतीतदिवसार्कस्य तदर्कस्य च विवरं स्फुटभुक्तिः ।
आदित्योदयास्तमयाद्वा चन्द्रोदयं दृष्ट्वा नग्रदद्धरितोऽर्कस्तेन कालेन चन्द्रमा भवति चन्द्रान्नक्षत्रज्ञानम्, चन्द्रार्कविवरात्तिथिज्ञानं तस्मादहर्गणः ।
स्फुटार्काद्विपरीतकर्मणा मध्यमार्कः ।
सौरजीवयोश्चारात्संवत्सरः ।
2.34.m:
Their comprehension and subtraction yield thereby the respiro-moments of the equator for one, two, and three signs. Diminished respectively by these respiro-moments, Aries, Taurus, and Gemini, and in reverse order Cancer, Leo, and Virgo, when combined with one's own locality, become the respiro-moments of rising with ascensional difference; and the very same in reverse order apply to Libra and the rest, and also to Pisces and the rest. The line drawn between the head and tail of the fish-figure traced between the tip and base of the midday shadow at midday and the south and north tips and bases is the east-west line. An eclipse of either the Sun or the Moon must not be calculated without the operation for difference in terrestrial longitude.
That is as follows: if it occurs at the elapsed time, then one's own locality is to be known as lying on the prime meridian.
Now, if the meridian is first and [the eclipse is] later, [one's locality is] to the east. One should multiply that time interval by sixty and divide by five thousand;
the result is the yojanas of difference in terrestrial longitude. The time from midnight to midday is the prior half for a planet, and from midday to the other part of the night is the later. There, without exceeding the Sun's time, one should take two shadows.
Its hypotenuse, inversely applied, diminished at the eastern and western ends of the gnomon—thereafter the equinoctial shadow is to be taken on the desired day. The difference between the latitude of the desired day and the equinoctial latitude, added from the shadows facing one direction, is the Sun's declination. Multiplying that by the radius, one should divide by the sine of maximum declination. The arc obtained is the Sun in the first quadrant; in the second quadrant it is subtracted from [six] signs;
added in the third, and in the fourth subtracted from the whole circle.
The equinoctial shadow, both young and waning, occurs when the Sun is in the first quadrant; diminished and waxing when it is in the second; waxing and greater when in the third; waning and greater when in the fourth. Thus, the difference between the Sun of the preceding day and that Sun is the true daily motion.
Or, having observed the rising of the Moon from the rising or setting of the Sun, the Sun is placed on the horizon; the Moon is determined by that time. From the Moon, knowledge of the lunar mansion is obtained; from the difference between the Sun and the Moon, knowledge of the lunar day; and from that, the sum of days.
From the true Sun, by inverse calculation, the mean Sun is found.
And from the course of Saturn and Jupiter, the year is determined.

uttarā rohiṇī saumyārdrā sārpa hasta citrā viśākhā maitrendra mūlāpyavāruṇānā yāmyāḥ .
revatyudayaḥ prācī sarvasya mahatī yogatārā rāśidvayaṃ saptaviṃśatirbhāgāḥ agastyadhruvakaḥ saptabhirmāgaistasya yāmyo vikṣepaḥ .
atha bhaumādīnāṃ vakrakendrāṇi rāśyādyāni pañcamanavaḥ khaṃ vedāḥ ṣaḍyamāḥ khaṃ pañca vedāḥ khaṃ pañca pañcadaśa khaṃ vedāstrayodaśa kham .
athānuvakrakendrāṇi ṣaḍṣoḍaśa khaṃ sapta vedāḥ khaṃ ṣaḍyamāḥ khaṃ (ṣaṭpañcaviṃśatiḥ khaṃkhaṃ manavaḥ khaṃ ṣaḍguṇāḥ khaṃ) saptadaśa kham .

चन्द्रवत्सर्वग्रहक्रिया,ग्रहेभ्यो वा कल्पगतकालज्ञानम्, एवं काल परिच्छेदः ।
अश्विन्यादीनां ध्रुवका राश्याद्याः, खमष्टौ खंखंखयमाः खंशशीमुनयोष्टयमाः शशीनवेन्दवोऽश्वयमाः पक्षौ गुणाः खपक्षौ शैलाः खंगुणा गुणाः खं गुणा षोडशखं त्रीद्व्यष्टादशखं वेदा रन्ध्राणि खं वेदाः सप्तयमाः खं शरा नखाः खं रसा पुष्करा खं रसा नवेन्दवः खं सप्त पक्षौ शरा मुनयो मनवो भूतानि च सप्त नवेन्दवः पञ्च अष्टौ च खं अष्टौ जनखं अष्टौ नखः खं अष्टौ चत्वारि खं नव वसवः खं सूयमुनयः खम् ।
अथैतेषां विक्षेपांशाः दश द्वादश पञ्चदश एकादश षड् खं सप्त खं द्वादश त्रयोदश एकादश द्वावष्टात्रिंशत्सार्धं त्रीणि चत्वारि सार्धान्यष्टौ पञ्चविभागाः पञ्च द्विषष्टिः त्रिंशत् अंशविभागः चतुर्विशतिः षड्विशतिः शून्यं चाश्विनी भरणी कृत्तिका पुनर्वसु पुष्य मघा भाग्यार्यमाणः ॥
स्वाति वैश्वदेवाभिजिच्छ्रवण धनिष्ठाजाहिर्बुध्न्य रेवतीनाम्।
उत्तरा रोहिणी सौम्यार्द्रा सार्प हस्त चित्रा विशाखा मैत्रेन्द्र मूलाप्यवारुणाना याम्याः ।
रेवत्युदयः प्राची सर्वस्य महती योगतारा राशिद्वयं सप्तविंशतिर्भागाः अगस्त्यध्रुवकः सप्तभिर्मागैस्तस्य याम्यो विक्षेपः ।
अथ भौमादीनां वक्रकेन्द्राणि राश्याद्यानि पञ्चमनवः खं वेदाः षड्यमाः खं पञ्च वेदाः खं पञ्च पञ्चदश खं वेदास्त्रयोदश खम् ।
अथानुवक्रकेन्द्राणि षड्षोडश खं सप्त वेदाः खं षड्यमाः खं (षट्पञ्चविंशतिः खंखं मनवः खं षड्गुणाः खं) सप्तदश खम् ।
2.34.m:
The calculation for all planets is like that of the Moon; or, from the planets, knowledge of the elapsed time of the aeon is obtained. In this manner is the determination of time.
The longitudinal coordinates of the lunar mansions beginning with Aśvinī, starting with signs: zero, eight; zero, zero, zero, two; zero, one, seven, twenty-eight; one, nineteen, twenty-two; two, three; zero, two, seven; zero, three, three; zero, three, sixteen; zero, three, two, eighteen; zero, four, nine; zero, four, twenty-seven; zero, five, twenty; zero, six, twenty-four; zero, six, nineteen; zero, seven, two; five, seven, fourteen, five, and seven, nineteen, five; eight and zero, eight, two, zero, eight, twenty; zero, eight, four; zero, nine, eight; zero, seven, zero.
Now, their degrees of celestial latitude: ten, twelve, fifteen, eleven, six, zero, seven, zero, twelve, thirteen, eleven, two, thirty-eight, three and a half, four, eight and a half, five degrees, five, sixty-two, thirty, twenty-four degrees, twenty-six, and zero; namely of Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, Kṛttikā, Punarvasu, Puṣya, Maghā, Pūrvaphālgunī, Uttaraphālgunī,

The rising of Revatī is the east; the junction-star of all of it is large; two signs and twenty-seven degrees is the coordinate of Agastya, and its southern latitude is by seventy degrees.

Now, the stations of direct motion: six, sixteen, zero; seven, four, zero; six, twenty, zero; (six, twenty-five, zero, zero; fourteen, zero; six, three, zero;) seventeen, zero.

atha pūrvādvārodayakendrāṇi khamaṣṭayamāḥ khaṃ ṣaṭpañcaviṃśatiḥ khaṃ khaṃ manaḥ khaṃ ṣaḍguṇāḥ khaṃ khaṃ saptadaśa kham .
atha paścārdhāstamayakendrāṇi ekādaśa dvau khaṃ pañcapañca khaṃ ekādaśaṣoḍaśa khaṃ pañcasaptaviṃśati khaṃ ekādaśa trayodaśa kham .
atha budhaśukrayoḥ pūrvārdhāstamayakendre daśadaśa khaṃ ekādaśa ṣoḍaśa khaṃ catvāri śūnyāni catvāri śūnyāni paṃcavedarasāgniyamapakṣāṣṭaśarendavaḥ kalpanapratinakṣatrodayaḥ ta evārkabhagaṇonā divasāḥ .
arkabhagaṇā dvādaśahatāstaṃ māsāstaistriṃśaddhatāstaddivasāścandrabhagaṇāḥ saptaviṃśati hatā nakṣatradivasāḥ bhagaṇāṃtaramarkendvoścandramasaste triṃśadguṇāstaddivasāścandramāsaḥ .
sūryamāsonādhimāsāścandradivasastu divasāntaramavamānīti .
2.34.d:
अथ पूर्वाद्वारोदयकेन्द्राणि खमष्टयमाः खं षट्पञ्चविंशतिः खं खं मनः खं षड्गुणाः खं खं सप्तदश खम् ।
अथ पश्चार्धास्तमयकेन्द्राणि एकादश द्वौ खं पञ्चपञ्च खं एकादशषोडश खं पञ्चसप्तविंशति खं एकादश त्रयोदश खम् ।
अथ बुधशुक्रयोः पूर्वार्धास्तमयकेन्द्रे दशदश खं एकादश षोडश खं चत्वारि शून्यानि चत्वारि शून्यानि पंचवेदरसाग्नियमपक्षाष्टशरेन्दवः कल्पनप्रतिनक्षत्रोदयः त एवार्कभगणोना दिवसाः ।
अर्कभगणा द्वादशहतास्तं मासास्तैस्त्रिंशद्धतास्तद्दिवसाश्चन्द्रभगणाः सप्तविंशति हता नक्षत्रदिवसाः भगणांतरमर्केन्द्वोश्चन्द्रमसस्ते त्रिंशद्गुणास्तद्दिवसाश्चन्द्रमासः ।
सूर्यमासोनाधिमासाश्चन्द्रदिवसस्तु दिवसान्तरमवमानीति ।
2.34.m:
Now, the anomalies for heliacal rising in the eastern quadrant: zero, eight, two; zero, six, twenty-five; zero, zero, fourteen; zero, six, three; zero, zero, seventeen, zero.
Now, the anomalies for heliacal setting in the western half: eleven, two, zero; five, five, zero; eleven, sixteen, zero; five, twenty-seven, zero; eleven, thirteen, zero.
Now, the anomalies for heliacal setting in the eastern half for Mercury and Venus: ten, ten, zero; eleven, sixteen, zero; four zeros, four zeros. The risings of the asterisms in an aeon are one, five, eight, two, two, three, six, four, five; those very [numbers] diminished by the revolutions of the Sun are the [terrestrial] days.
The revolutions of the Sun multiplied by twelve are its months; multiplied by thirty, they are its days. The revolutions of the Moon multiplied by twenty-seven are sidereal days. The difference between the revolutions of the Sun and the Moon gives the lunar months; these multiplied by thirty are their lunar days.
[The lunar months] diminished by the solar months are the intercalary months; the difference between the lunar days and the [civil] days gives the omitted lunar days.

2.35.s:
.. samāptaṃ paitāmahasiddhāntam .
2.175
śrīparaśurāma uvāca ..
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada ..
jigīṣūṇāṃ samācakṣva yātrākālaṃ mahīkṣitām .. 1 ..
2.35.d:
॥ समाप्तं पैतामहसिद्धान्तम् ।
2.175
श्रीपरशुराम उवाच ॥
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद ॥
जिगीषूणां समाचक्ष्व यात्राकालं महीक्षिताम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.35.m:
The Paitāmaha Siddhānta is concluded.
2.175
The illustrious Paraśurāma said:
O blessed one, knower of all dharmas, expert in all scriptures,
explain to me the time of military expeditions for kings who desire victory.

2.35.s:
puṣkara uvāca ..
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ yātrākālaṃ nibodha me ..
adhikṛtya mahīnāthaṃ vijigīṣorguṇānvitam .. 2 ..
2.35.d:
पुष्कर उवाच ॥
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां यात्राकालं निबोध मे ॥
अधिकृत्य महीनाथं विजिगीषोर्गुणान्वितम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.35.m:
Puṣkara said:
Learn from me the time of military expeditions for all varnas,
with reference to an endowed king of the earth who desires victory.

2.35.s:
pūrve kapāle pauro'rke yāyī bhavati cāpare ..
yāyigrahau śukrakujau śeṣāḥ paurāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 3 ..
2.35.d:
पूर्वे कपाले पौरोऽर्के यायी भवति चापरे ॥
यायिग्रहौ शुक्रकुजौ शेषाः पौराः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 3 ॥
2.35.m:
When the sun is in the eastern hemisphere, [a planet] is a defender, and in the other, it becomes an attacker.
Venus and Mars are attacking planets; the others are declared to be defending planets.

2.35.s:
pauragrahairbalopetairna yātrāṃ samprayojayet ..
yāyigrahabale rājā nityaṃ yātrāṃ prayojayet .. 4 ..
2.35.d:
पौरग्रहैर्बलोपेतैर्न यात्रां सम्प्रयोजयेत् ॥
यायिग्रहबले राजा नित्यं यात्रां प्रयोजयेत् ॥ 4 ॥
2.35.m:
One should not undertake a march when the defending planets are endowed with strength;
a king should always undertake a march when the attacking planets are strong.

2.35.s:
(astaṃ gate nīcagate vivaśe ripurāśige ..
pratilomaṃ ca viddhvaste śukre yātrāṃ vivarjayet .. 5 ..
2.35.d:
(अस्तं गते नीचगते विवशे रिपुराशिगे ॥
प्रतिलोमं च विद्ध्वस्ते शुक्रे यात्रां विवर्जयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
2.35.m:
When Venus has set, entered its debilitation, is powerless, entered an enemy's sign,
retrograde, or afflicted, one should avoid a military expedition.

2.35.s:
pratilome budhe yātrā dikpatau ca tathā grahe ..
viṣṭo vṛṣṭyāṃ vāti vāte vātyāyāñca vivarjayeta .. 6 ..
2.35.d:
प्रतिलोमे बुधे यात्रा दिक्पतौ च तथा ग्रहे ॥
विष्टो वृष्ट्यां वाति वाते वात्यायाञ्च विवर्जयेत ॥ 6 ॥
2.35.m:
When Mercury is retrograde, and likewise the planet that is the regent of the direction [of travel], an expedition [should be avoided];
and one should avoid [it] during Viṣṭi, during rain, when the wind blows hard, and in a whirlwind.

2.35.s:
vaidhṛte ca vyatīpāte nāge ca śakunau tathā ..
catuṣpade ca kiṃstughne tathā yātrāṃ vivarjayet .. .. 7 ..
2.35.d:
वैधृते च व्यतीपाते नागे च शकुनौ तथा ॥
चतुष्पदे च किंस्तुघ्ने तथा यात्रां विवर्जयेत् ॥ ॥ 7 ॥
2.35.m:
And during Vaidhṛta, Vyatīpāta, Nāga, Śakuni,
Catuṣpada, and Kiṃstughna, one should likewise avoid an expedition.

2.35.s:
vipatkare naidhane ca pratyarau bhe ca janmani ..
gaṇe vivarjayedyātrāṃ riktāyāṃ ca tithāvapi .. 8 ..
2.35.d:
विपत्करे नैधने च प्रत्यरौ भे च जन्मनि ॥
गणे विवर्जयेद्यात्रां रिक्तायां च तिथावपि ॥ 8 ॥
2.35.m:
During the asterisms that bring danger, that cause death, the adversary asterism, the birth asterism,
in the asterism group [so classified], and also on an empty lunar day, one should avoid an expedition.

2.35.s:
udīcī ca tathā prācī tayoraikyaṃ prakīrtitam ..
paścimā dakṣiṇā yā diktayoraikyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 9 ..
2.35.d:
उदीची च तथा प्राची तयोरैक्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
पश्चिमा दक्षिणा या दिक्तयोरैक्यं तथैव च ॥ 9 ॥
2.35.m:
The north and the east: their union is declared [concordant];
and that direction which is west and south, likewise their union.

2.35.s:
vāyvagnidiksamudbhūtaṃ paridhintu na laṃghayet ..
rāma saṃvatsarādyeṣu sarveṣveva mahīpatiḥ .. 2.175.10 ..
2.35.d:
वाय्वग्निदिक्समुद्भूतं परिधिन्तु न लंघयेत् ॥
राम संवत्सराद्येषु सर्वेष्वेव महीपतिः ॥ 2.175.10 ॥
2.35.m:
A king should not cross a solar or lunar halo arising in the northwest or southeast quarters,
O Rāma, at the beginning of the year and all [such occasions].

2.35.s:
saṃvatsaramadikprācī paripūrvasya dakṣiṇā ..
tatpūrvasyāparā jñeyā cānupūrvasya dakṣiṇā .. 11 ..
2.35.d:
संवत्सरमदिक्प्राची परिपूर्वस्य दक्षिणा ॥
तत्पूर्वस्यापरा ज्ञेया चानुपूर्वस्य दक्षिणा ॥ 11 ॥
2.35.m: The direction of the Saṃvatsara is east, of the Parivatsara south; / of that preceding it (Idāvatsara) west is known, and of the Anuvatsara south.

2.35.s:
advārastu vinirdiṣṭastathā vatsarasaṃjñitaḥ ..
uttarāyaṇage sūrye prācīṃ yāyāddiśaṃ nṛpaḥ .. 12 ..
2.35.d:
अद्वारस्तु विनिर्दिष्टस्तथा वत्सरसंज्ञितः ॥
उत्तरायणगे सूर्ये प्राचीं यायाद्दिशं नृपः ॥ 12 ॥
2.35.m: The one termed Vatsara is declared to have no gate. / When the sun is in the northern course, the king should go in the eastern direction;

2.35.s:
candre ca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha paścimāṃ dakṣiṇasthite ..
tayorayanabhedena yāyātsūryāyanaṃ divā .. 13 ..
2.35.d:
चन्द्रे च ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ पश्चिमां दक्षिणस्थिते ॥
तयोरयनभेदेन यायात्सूर्यायनं दिवा ॥ 13 ॥
2.35.m: and when the moon, O best of brahmins, is in the south, [he should go] in the west. / According to their respective courses, one should go by day in the sun's course,

2.35.s:
rātrau cāndrāyaṇaṃ yāyādyā diguktā mayā tava ..
vasanta uttaradvāre grīṣmaḥ prāgdvārikastathā .. 14 ..
2.35.d:
रात्रौ चान्द्रायणं यायाद्या दिगुक्ता मया तव ॥
वसन्त उत्तरद्वारे ग्रीष्मः प्राग्द्वारिकस्तथा ॥ 14 ॥
2.35.m: and at night in the moon's course, in whichever direction has been stated to you by me. / Spring has its gate in the north, summer likewise has an eastern gate,

2.35.s:
śaracca paścimadvāraḥ śiśiraścottarāmukhaḥ ..
hemantaḥ sarvatodvāraḥ prāvṛḍadvārikā smṛtā .. 15 ..
2.35.d:
शरच्च पश्चिमद्वारः शिशिरश्चोत्तरामुखः ॥
हेमन्तः सर्वतोद्वारः प्रावृडद्वारिका स्मृता ॥ 15 ॥
2.35.m: autumn has a western gate, and winter (śiśira) faces north; / hemanta has gates on all sides, while the rainy season is remembered as having no gate.

2.35.s:
nakṣatravaddevatābhiryā yasya tu digucyate ..
māsārdhe'sya mahābhāga tathaiva parikīrtitā .. 16 ..
2.35.d:
नक्षत्रवद्देवताभिर्या यस्य तु दिगुच्यते ॥
मासार्धेऽस्य महाभाग तथैव परिकीर्तिता ॥ 16 ॥
2.35.m: Whichever direction is stated for one through deities like the asterisms, / that very one is proclaimed for its half-month, O fortunate one.

2.35.s:
ādityacandrasaurārkadivasāstu na śobhanāḥ ..
ta eva cānukūlasya divaso na praśasyate .. 17 ..
2.35.d:
आदित्यचन्द्रसौरार्कदिवसास्तु न शोभनाः ॥
त एव चानुकूलस्य दिवसो न प्रशस्यते ॥ 17 ॥
2.35.m: The days of the sun, the moon, Saturn, and the sun are not auspicious; / on those days, even of one that is favorable, the day is not praised.

2.35.s:
prāgdvāro bhāskaro jñeyo dakṣiṇena tathā kujaḥ ..
paścimena śanaiścārī udagdvārastu candramāḥ .. 18 ..
2.35.d:
प्राग्द्वारो भास्करो ज्ञेयो दक्षिणेन तथा कुजः ॥
पश्चिमेन शनैश्चारी उदग्द्वारस्तु चन्द्रमाः ॥ 18 ॥
2.35.m: The Sun is to be known as having an eastern gate, and likewise Mars as southern; / Saturn has a western [gate], and the Moon has a northern gate.

2.35.s:
sarvadvārāḥ smṛtā rāma jīvaśukrendunandanāḥ ..
teṣāṃ hi divasāḥ śastā viśeṣeṇa gamiṣyatām ..19..
2.35.d:
सर्वद्वाराः स्मृता राम जीवशुक्रेन्दुनन्दनाः ॥
तेषां हि दिवसाः शस्ता विशेषेण गमिष्यताम् ॥19॥
2.35.m: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury are remembered as having gates in all directions, O Rāma; / their days are indeed praised, especially for those about to set out.

2.35.s:
samāgame jito yastu jīvo mitragṛhe sthitaḥ..
sphuraṇo raśmihīnaśca na praśaṃsanti taddinam ..2.175.20..
2.35.d:
समागमे जितो यस्तु जीवो मित्रगृहे स्थितः॥
स्फुरणो रश्मिहीनश्च न प्रशंसन्ति तद्दिनम् ॥2.175.20॥
2.35.m: Jupiter who is defeated in planetary conjunction, stationed in a friend's house, / flickering, and devoid of rays—they do not praise his day.

2.35.s:
uccastho mitragṛhagaḥ svakṣetrasthaśca yo grahaḥ ..
vijayī raśmivāṃsthūlo dinaṃ tasya praśasyate..21..
2.35.d:
उच्चस्थो मित्रगृहगः स्वक्षेत्रस्थश्च यो ग्रहः ॥
विजयी रश्मिवांस्थूलो दिनं तस्य प्रशस्यते॥21॥
2.35.m: A planet that is exalted, stationed in a friend's house, or in its own sign, / victorious, full of rays, and large—its day is praised.

2.35.s:
kṛttikādyāni pūrveṇa maghādyāni ca yāmyataḥ..
maitrādyāḥ paścimenātha vāsavādyāni cāpyudak .. 22 ..
2.35.d:
कृत्तिकाद्यानि पूर्वेण मघाद्यानि च याम्यतः॥
मैत्राद्याः पश्चिमेनाथ वासवाद्यानि चाप्युदक् ॥ 22 ॥
2.35.m: The asterisms beginning with Kṛttikā are in the east, those beginning with Maghā in the south, / those beginning with Maitra (Anurādhā) in the west, and those beginning with Vāsava (Dhaniṣṭhā) in the north.

2.35.s:
sarvadvārāṇi tatrāpi divādyāni vinirdiśet ..
bhavanti stambhasaṃjñāni tāni diṅmadhyagāni ca .. 23 ..
2.35.d:
सर्वद्वाराणि तत्रापि दिवाद्यानि विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
भवन्ति स्तम्भसंज्ञानि तानि दिङ्मध्यगानि च ॥ 23 ॥
2.35.m: There too one should declare all gates beginning with the day; / those situated in the middle of a direction are called pillars (stambha).

2.35.s:
stambharkṣādyāni pūrvāṇi tāni prāveśikāni tu ..
nirgamarkṣāṇi jānīyātstambharkṣāduttarāṇi tu..24..
2.35.d:
स्तम्भर्क्षाद्यानि पूर्वाणि तानि प्रावेशिकानि तु ॥
निर्गमर्क्षाणि जानीयात्स्तम्भर्क्षादुत्तराणि तु॥24॥
2.35.m: Those [asterisms] preceding the pillar asterisms are entering (prāveśika); / one should know those following the pillar asterisms to be departing (nirgama) asterisms.

2.35.s:
praveśabheṣu duṣṭeṣu yāyināṃ vijayaṃ vadet ..
stambhabheṣu tu duṣṭeṣu durgāṇāṃ grahaṇe tadā ..25..
2.35.d:
प्रवेशभेषु दुष्टेषु यायिनां विजयं वदेत् ॥
स्तम्भभेषु तु दुष्टेषु दुर्गाणां ग्रहणे तदा ॥25॥
2.35.m: When the entering asterisms are afflicted, one should predict victory for the invaders; / but when the pillar asterisms are afflicted, then in taking fortresses [victory is won].

2.35.s:
nirgamarkṣeṣu duṣṭeṣu nāgarāṇāṃ jayaṃ vadet ..
ṛkṣe pāpagrahākrānte tathā cāstamite dvija .. 26 ..
2.35.d:
निर्गमर्क्षेषु दुष्टेषु नागराणां जयं वदेत् ॥
ऋक्षे पापग्रहाक्रान्ते तथा चास्तमिते द्विज ॥ 26 ॥
2.35.m: When the departing asterisms are afflicted, one should predict victory for the city defenders. / When an asterism is occupied by a malefic planet, or eclipsed, O twice-born,

2.35.s:
dagdhe ca dhūmite vāpi rajasopahate'tha vā ..
ketunā dhūmite vāpi pariviṣṭe'thavā punaḥ '. .. 27 ..
2.35.d:
दग्धे च धूमिते वापि रजसोपहतेऽथ वा ॥
केतुना धूमिते वापि परिविष्टेऽथवा पुनः '॥। 27 ॥
2.35.m: and when it is burned, or smoked, or struck by dust, / or smoked by a comet, or surrounded by a halo,

2.35.s:
utpātadarśanaṃ ca syādyena carkṣeṇa bhārgava ..
saṃkrāntirvā grahasya syādyena cāstodayau tathā .. 28 ..
2.35.d:
उत्पातदर्शनं च स्याद्येन चर्क्षेण भार्गव ॥
संक्रान्तिर्वा ग्रहस्य स्याद्येन चास्तोदयौ तथा ॥ 28 ॥
2.35.m: and by whichever asterism a portent is seen, O descendant of Bhṛgu, / or by which a planet undergoes ingress, setting, or rising,

2.35.s:
bhinnaścandramasā yaśca graheṇānyena vā punaḥ ..
yannakṣatragatau grastau syātāṃ vā śaśibhāskarau .. 29 ..
2.35.d:
भिन्नश्चन्द्रमसा यश्च ग्रहेणान्येन वा पुनः ॥
यन्नक्षत्रगतौ ग्रस्तौ स्यातां वा शशिभास्करौ ॥ 29 ॥
2.35.m: and that which is occulted by the Moon or by another planet, / or in which asterism the Moon and Sun are eclipsed,

2.35.s:
na tena nṛpatiryāyānnakṣatreṇa kadācana ..
aṣṭavargānukūlastha candre yātrāṃ prayojayet .. 2.175.30 ..
2.35.d:
न तेन नृपतिर्यायान्नक्षत्रेण कदाचन ॥
अष्टवर्गानुकूलस्थ चन्द्रे यात्रां प्रयोजयेत् ॥ 2.175.30 ॥
2.35.m: under that asterism a king should never set out on a march. / One should undertake an expedition when the moon is situated favorably according to the aṣṭakavarga.

2.35.s:
pūrvadvārasthitānandā bhadrā dakṣiṇataḥ sthitā ..
jayā ca paścimadvārā riktā codakprakīrtitā .. 31 ..
2.35.d:
पूर्वद्वारस्थितानन्दा भद्रा दक्षिणतः स्थिता ॥
जया च पश्चिमद्वारा रिक्ता चोदक्प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 31 ॥
2.35.m: Nandā is situated in the eastern gate, Bhadrā is situated in the south; / Jayā has a western gate, and Riktā is proclaimed to be in the north.

2.35.s:
pūrṇā tu sarvato dvārā tithiruktā mahābhuja ..
nakṣatradevatātulyā muhūrtānāṃ tu digbhavet .. 32 ..
2.35.d:
पूर्णा तु सर्वतो द्वारा तिथिरुक्ता महाभुज ॥
नक्षत्रदेवतातुल्या मुहूर्तानां तु दिग्भवेत् ॥ 32 ॥
2.35.m: Pūrṇā is stated to be a lunar day with gates in all directions, O mighty-armed one. / The direction of the muhūrtas is identical with that of their asterism-deity.

2.35.s:
tridigdvārābhijijjñeyā dakṣiṇena vigarhitā ..
prāgdvārāḥ kathitā rāma meṣasiṃhadhanurdharāḥ .. 33 ..
2.35.d:
त्रिदिग्द्वाराभिजिज्ज्ञेया दक्षिणेन विगर्हिता ॥
प्राग्द्वाराः कथिता राम मेषसिंहधनुर्धराः ॥ 33 ॥
2.35.m: Abhijit is to be known as having gates in three directions, censure attaching to it in the south. / Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius are declared to have eastern gates, O Rāma;

2.35.s:
tathā ca paścimadvārāḥ kanyāmakaragovṛṣāḥ ..
tulāmakarakumbhāśca jñeyāḥ paścimadiṅmukhāḥ .. 34 ..
2.35.d:
तथा च पश्चिमद्वाराः कन्यामकरगोवृषाः ॥
तुलामकरकुम्भाश्च ज्ञेयाः पश्चिमदिङ्मुखाः ॥ 34 ॥
2.35.m: and Virgo, Capricorn, and Taurus have western gates; / Libra, Capricorn, and Aquarius are to be known as facing the western direction;

2.35.s:
kīṭavṛścikamīnāśca tathā codakprakīrtitāḥ ..
lagnena diṅmukhaṃ yatnājjñeyaṃ prāṅmukhamaṃśakam .. 35 ..
2.35.d:
कीटवृश्चिकमीनाश्च तथा चोदक्प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
लग्नेन दिङ्मुखं यत्नाज्ज्ञेयं प्राङ्मुखमंशकम् ॥ 35 ॥
2.35.m: and Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces are proclaimed to face north. / By means of the ascendant, the direction of the face should be carefully known, with its division facing east.

2.35.s:
saurāḥ sarve praśasyante kālarodhaṃ vivarjayet '.
viśākhādyaṃ bhatritayaṃ dīne sūrye vivarjayet .. 36 ..
2.35.d:
सौराः सर्वे प्रशस्यन्ते कालरोधं विवर्जयेत् '.
विशाखाद्यं भत्रितयं दीने सूर्ये विवर्जयेत् ॥ 36 ॥
2.35.m: All solar asterisms are praised; one should avoid obstruction of time (kālarodha). / When the sun is weakened, one should avoid the triad of asterisms beginning with Viśākhā;

2.35.s:
āṣāḍhātritayaṃ candre tathā brāhmaṇasaṃjñakam ..
dhaniṣṭhādyatrayaṃ bhaume pauṣṇādyatritayaṃ budhe. .. 37 ..
2.35.d:
आषाढात्रितयं चन्द्रे तथा ब्राह्मणसंज्ञकम् ॥
धनिष्ठाद्यत्रयं भौमे पौष्णाद्यत्रितयं बुधे॥। 37 ॥
2.35.m: [in the case of] the moon, the triad of Āṣāḍhās, likewise termed brāhmaṇa; / [in the case of] Mars, the triad beginning with Dhaniṣṭhā; [in the case of] Mercury, the triad beginning with Pauṣṇa (Revatī);

2.35.s:
rohiṇyādyaṃ tathā jīve puṣyādyaṃ ca tathā site ..
aryamṇādya tathā saure prayatnena mahābhuja .. 38 ..
2.35.d:
रोहिण्याद्यं तथा जीवे पुष्याद्यं च तथा सिते ॥
अर्यम्णाद्य तथा सौरे प्रयत्नेन महाभुज ॥ 38 ॥
2.35.m: likewise, [in the case of] Jupiter, that beginning with Rohiṇī; in the case of Venus, that beginning with Puṣya; / and in the case of Saturn, that beginning with Aryaman (Uttaraphalgunī), with great care, O mighty-armed one.

2.35.s:
mūlaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ caiva āhirbudhnyaṃ tathaiva ca ..
āgneyamatha cādityaṃ bhāgyaṃ vāyavyameva vā .. 39 ..
2.35.d:
मूलं च श्रवणं चैव आहिर्बुध्न्यं तथैव च ॥
आग्नेयमथ चादित्यं भाग्यं वायव्यमेव वा ॥ 39 ॥
2.35.m: Mūla, Śravaṇa, Āhirbudhnya (Uttarabhadrapadā), / Āgneya (Kṛttikā), Āditya (Punarvasu), Bhāgya (Pūrvaphalgunī), or Vāyavya (Svātī)—

2.35.s:
ādityādidineṣvete siddhiyogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
siddhiyogānviśeṣeṇa tithiṣvapi nibodha me .. 2.175.40 ..
2.35.d:
आदित्यादिदिनेष्वेते सिद्धियोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
सिद्धियोगान्विशेषेण तिथिष्वपि निबोध मे ॥ 2.175.40 ॥
2.35.m: these on the days beginning with Sunday are proclaimed combinations for success (siddhiyoga). / Learn from me also the combinations for success particularly in the lunar days,

2.35.s:
grahakrameṇa dharmajña sarvakarmasu siddhidān ..
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca pratipaccāṣṭamī tathā .. 41 ..
2.35.d:
ग्रहक्रमेण धर्मज्ञ सर्वकर्मसु सिद्धिदान् ॥
द्वितीया च तृतीया च प्रतिपच्चाष्टमी तथा ॥ 41 ॥
2.35.m: which bestow success in all undertakings in the order of the planets, O knower of dharma: / the second, the third, the first, and the eighth,

2.35.s:
saptamī ca caturthī ca pañcamī ca tathā tithiḥ ..
anyāśca siddhayogeṣu tithayastvaṃ śṛṇu kramāt .. 42 ..
2.35.d:
सप्तमी च चतुर्थी च पञ्चमी च तथा तिथिः ॥
अन्याश्च सिद्धयोगेषु तिथयस्त्वं शृणु क्रमात् ॥ 42 ॥
2.35.m: the seventh, the fourth, and the fifth lunar day. / Hear the other lunar days in regular order in combinations for success:

2.35.s:
ekādaśī ca daśamī navamī pañcadaśyapi ..
caturdaśī dvādaśī ca tathā rāma trayodaśī .. 43 ..
2.35.d:
एकादशी च दशमी नवमी पञ्चदश्यपि ॥
चतुर्दशी द्वादशी च तथा राम त्रयोदशी ॥ 43 ॥
2.35.m: the eleventh, the tenth, the ninth, and the fifteenth; / the fourteenth, the twelfth, and likewise the thirteenth, O Rāma.

2.35.s:
chāyāpramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi siddhiyogeṣvataḥ kramāt ..
tatra kāle kṛtaṃ karma sakṛtsaṃpaśyate dhruvam .. 44 ..
2.35.d:
छायाप्रमाणं वक्ष्यामि सिद्धियोगेष्वतः क्रमात् ॥
तत्र काले कृतं कर्म सकृत्संपश्यते ध्रुवम् ॥ 44 ॥
2.35.m: I shall state the measure of the shadow hereafter in the combinations for success in order. / An action performed at that time is firmly seen to succeed at once.

2.35.s:
āditye viṃśatirjñeyāścandre ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ ..
bhaume pañcadaśaivoktāścaturdaśa tathā budhe .. 45 ..
2.35.d:
आदित्ये विंशतिर्ज्ञेयाश्चन्द्रे षोडश कीर्तिताः ॥
भौमे पञ्चदशैवोक्ताश्चतुर्दश तथा बुधे ॥ 45 ॥
2.35.m: On Sunday twenty [feet] are to be known, on Monday sixteen are proclaimed, / on Tuesday fifteen are declared, and on Wednesday fourteen,

2.35.s:
trayodaśa tathā jīve śukre dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ..
uditenottarāṃ gacchetprācīṃ madhyasthite ravau .. 46 ..
2.35.d:
त्रयोदश तथा जीवे शुक्रे द्वादश कीर्तिताः ॥
उदितेनोत्तरां गच्छेत्प्राचीं मध्यस्थिते रवौ ॥ 46 ॥
2.35.m: on Thursday thirteen, and on Friday twelve are proclaimed. / At sunrise one should go north; when the sun is at the meridian, to the east;

2.35.s:
dakṣiṇāmaparāhṇe tu ardharātre tu paścimām ..
janmarāśyudaye yātrā na praśastā mahābhuja .. 47 ..
2.35.d:
दक्षिणामपराह्णे तु अर्धरात्रे तु पश्चिमाम् ॥
जन्मराश्युदये यात्रा न प्रशस्ता महाभुज ॥ 47 ॥
2.35.m: to the south in the afternoon, and at midnight to the west. / An expedition is not praised at the rising of the birth sign, O mighty-armed one.

2.35.s:
tābhyāmupacayarkṣe tu yātrā śastā tathā bhavet ..
śeṣeṣu varjayedyātrāṃ bhūtikāmo narādhipaḥ .. 48 ..
2.35.d:
ताभ्यामुपचयर्क्षे तु यात्रा शस्ता तथा भवेत् ॥
शेषेषु वर्जयेद्यात्रां भूतिकामो नराधिपः ॥ 48 ॥
2.35.m: An expedition undertaken under the upacaya asterisms from them is auspicious; / during the rest, a ruler of men desiring prosperity should avoid an expedition.

2.35.s:
yātrā śubhaphalā jñeyā saumyagrahanavāṃśake ..
pāpagrahāṃśake yātrāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet .. 49 ..
2.35.d:
यात्रा शुभफला ज्ञेया सौम्यग्रहनवांशके ॥
पापग्रहांशके यात्रां प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् ॥ 49 ॥
2.35.m: An expedition is to be known as bearing auspicious fruit in the navāṃśa of a benefic planet; / one should diligently avoid an expedition in the navāṃśa of a malefic planet.

2.35.s:
janmabhe naidhane caiva tathādhāne vipatkare ..
pratyarau bhagaṇe yātrāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet .. 2.175.50 ..
2.35.d:
जन्मभे नैधने चैव तथाधाने विपत्करे ॥
प्रत्यरौ भगणे यात्रां प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत् ॥ 2.175.50 ॥
2.35.m: One should diligently avoid an expedition in the birth asterism, in the naidhana, in the ādhāna, in the vipatkara, / and in the pratyari asterism of the zodiac;

2.35.s:
kṣeme saṃpatkare maitre sādhake cātimaitrake ..
karmabhe ca tathā yātrā praśastā manujottama .. 51 ..
2.35.d:
क्षेमे संपत्करे मैत्रे साधके चातिमैत्रके ॥
कर्मभे च तथा यात्रा प्रशस्ता मनुजोत्तम ॥ 51 ॥
2.35.m: an expedition is praised in the kṣema, the saṃpatkara, the maitra, the sādhaka, the atimaitra, / and in the karma asterism, O best of men.

2.35.s:
divyāntarikṣakṣitije dṛṣṭe rāma mahādbhute ..
saptāhaṃ varjeyedyātrāṃ prayatnena mahābhuja .. 52 ..
2.35.d:
दिव्यान्तरिक्षक्षितिजे दृष्टे राम महाद्भुते ॥
सप्ताहं वर्जेयेद्यात्रां प्रयत्नेन महाभुज ॥ 52 ॥
2.35.m: When a great portent of the sky, the atmosphere, or the earth is seen, O Rāma, / one should diligently avoid an expedition for seven days, O mighty-armed one.

2.35.s:
lagne tu vibale yātrāṃ śūnye kendre ca varjayet ..
janmape lagnape rāma balahīne viśeṣataḥ .. 53 ..
2.35.d:
लग्ने तु विबले यात्रां शून्ये केन्द्रे च वर्जयेत् ॥
जन्मपे लग्नपे राम बलहीने विशेषतः ॥ 53 ॥
2.35.m: One should avoid an expedition when the ascendant is weak and the kendra empty, / especially, O Rāma, when the lord of the birth sign or the lord of the ascendant is devoid of strength.

2.35.s:
dikpatāvanukūle tu śubhā yātrā prakīrtitā ..
sammukhe śakracāpe tu yātrāṃ yatnena varjayet .. 54 ..
2.35.d:
दिक्पतावनुकूले तु शुभा यात्रा प्रकीर्तिता ॥
सम्मुखे शक्रचापे तु यात्रां यत्नेन वर्जयेत् ॥ 54 ॥
2.35.m: When the guardian of the direction is favorable, an expedition is proclaimed to be auspicious; / but when a rainbow faces directly ahead, one should diligently avoid an expedition.

2.35.s:
na ca gacchettathā rāma dvārābhihatamastakaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā dravyamamaṅgalyaṃ khinnacetāstathaiva ca ..
tuṣṭe manasi gantavyaṃ prayatnena mahībhujā .. 55 ..
2.35.d:
न च गच्छेत्तथा राम द्वाराभिहतमस्तकः ॥
दृष्ट्वा द्रव्यममङ्गल्यं खिन्नचेतास्तथैव च ॥
तुष्टे मनसि गन्तव्यं प्रयत्नेन महीभुजा ॥ 55 ॥
2.35.m: And he should not set out, O Rāma, if his head has struck a doorframe, / or having seen an inauspicious object, or if his mind is distressed; / the king should set out with diligence only when his mind is pleased.

2.35.s:
trikoṇa kendropagatāstu saumyāḥ pāpāstathā copacayarkṣasaṃsthāḥ ..
bhavanti lagnasya tu yasya tena yātrā prayuktā tu śubhāvahā syāt .. 56 ..
2.35.d:
त्रिकोण केन्द्रोपगतास्तु सौम्याः पापास्तथा चोपचयर्क्षसंस्थाः ॥
भवन्ति लग्नस्य तु यस्य तेन यात्रा प्रयुक्ता तु शुभावहा स्यात् ॥ 56 ॥
2.35.m: Benefic planets situated in trines and angles, and malefic planets situated in the upacaya houses / of the ascendant—an expedition undertaken by one whose [chart has them so] will bring good fortune.
